instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to shrink</lang> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: When you wash wool clothes too hot, they may shrink.
atoms.b: When you wash wool clothes too hot, they may ((shrink)).

atoms.sound: In my last wash, my jumper shrank a bit, but luckily it still fit me.
atoms.b: In my last wash, my jumper ((shrank)) a bit, but luckily it still fit me.

atoms.sound: This time I am not that lucky because my favourite jumper has shrunk to half its size.
atoms.b: This time I am not that lucky because my favourite jumper has ((shrunk)) to half its size.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to upset in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to upset</lang> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: Ella often upsets her mother when she talks about moving out.
atoms.b: Ella often ((upsets)) her mother when she talks about moving out.

atoms.sound: Last night, she upset her mum by telling her that she wants to be independent after school.
atoms.b: Last night, she ((upset)) her mum by telling her that she wants to be independent after school.

atoms.sound: She has upset her parents many times with this topic, though she never means to hurt them.
atoms.b: She has ((upset)) her parents many times with this topic, though she never means to hurt them.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to thrust in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to thrust</lang> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: Joan the gallant knight thrusts her sword forward to attack her opponent.
atoms.b: Joan the gallant knight ((thrusts)) her sword forward to attack her opponent.

atoms.sound: During her last battle, she thrust her blade with great impact into the opponents shield and broke it.
atoms.b: During her last battle, she ((thrust)) her blade with great impact into the opponents shield and broke it.

atoms.sound: Joan has thrust herself into many battles before and always won.
atoms.b: Joan has ((thrust)) herself into many battles before and always won.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to swing in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to swing</lang> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: Gerda and Kai like to swing on the tire swing in the garden.
atoms.b: Gerda and Kai like to ((swing)) on the tire swing in the garden.

atoms.sound: Kai swung so high yesterday that he almost touched the tree branches.
atoms.b: Kai ((swung)) so high yesterday that he almost touched the tree branches.

atoms.sound: Both of them have swung on the swing since they were little.
atoms.b: Both of them have ((swung)) on the swing since they were little.
